paragraphs: Mentioned in [Kiddushin 32a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.32a.15): Rav Yitzchak bar Shila said in the name of Rav Matna, who spoke in Rav Chisda’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Kiddushin gives Rav Yitzchak bar Shila, Rav Matna and Rav Chisda in that order. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2212&lang=en) notes that this indirect report is distinct from speaking directly in Rav Chisda’s name.
